ex.en: Where's the checkout counter?
ex.zh: 結帳櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: There was a long line at the checkout.
ex.zh: 結帳櫃檯大排長龍。

ex.en: Add items to your cart and proceed to checkout.
ex.zh: 把商品加入購物車，然後前往結帳。

checkout.en: the place in a shop where you pay for things

ex.en: Checkout time is 11 a.m.
ex.zh: 退房時間是上午十一點。

ex.en: Can I have a late checkout?
ex.zh: 我可以延後退房嗎？

checkout.en: the time or act of leaving a hotel and paying

ex.en: I majored in chemistry at the university.
ex.zh: 我大學主修化學。

ex.en: Which do you like better, physics or chemistry?
ex.zh: 物理和化學，你比較喜歡哪一科？

chemistry.en: the science of substances and how they change

ex.en: There's great chemistry between the two actors.
ex.zh: 這兩位演員之間很有火花。

ex.en: The team has good chemistry.
ex.zh: 這個團隊默契很好。

chemistry.en: a strong feeling of connection between two people

ex.en: Mike was elected chairperson.
ex.zh: 麥克當選為主席。

ex.en: We elected her chairperson.
ex.zh: 我們選她為主席。

ex.en: She was appointed chairperson.
ex.zh: 她被任命為主席。

chairperson.en: a person in charge of a meeting or an organization

ex.en: She donates to several charitable organizations.
ex.zh: 她捐款給好幾個慈善機構。

ex.en: The company supports many charitable causes.
ex.zh: 這家公司支持許多慈善公益活動。

charitable.en: giving help or money to people who need it

ex.en: I'd like a cheeseburger and fries, please.
ex.zh: 我要一個起司漢堡和薯條。

ex.en: This place makes the best cheeseburgers in town.
ex.zh: 這家店的起司漢堡是全城最好吃的。

cheeseburger.en: a sandwich with a cooked meat patty and cheese in a round bread roll

ex.en: My sister is cheering for a young Sumo wrestler.
ex.zh: 我姊姊在幫一位年輕的相撲選手加油。

ex.en: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
ex.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾歡呼起來。

cheer.en: to shout to show support or happiness

ex.en: The situation is improving, so cheer up!
ex.zh: 情況在好轉，振作起來吧！

ex.en: After hearing the news, she cheered up.
ex.zh: 聽到這個消息後，她開心起來了。

ex.en: The flowers cheered her up.
ex.zh: 那些花讓她心情好了起來。

cheer.en: to become happier, or to make someone feel happier

ex.en: The audience gave a loud cheer.
ex.zh: 觀眾大聲歡呼。

ex.en: Cheers filled the stadium after the final goal.
ex.zh: 最後一球進門後，體育場內充滿了歡呼聲。

cheer.en: a loud shout of support or happiness

ex.en: The German chancellor visited Paris last week.
ex.zh: 德國總理上週訪問了巴黎。

ex.en: The chancellor of the university gave a speech.
ex.zh: 大學校長發表了演說。

chancellor.en: the leader of the government in some countries, or the head of a university

ex.en: We chartered a bus for the company trip.
ex.zh: 我們為員工旅遊包了一台遊覽車。

ex.en: The team chartered a plane to the game.
ex.zh: 球隊包機去比賽。

charter.en: to pay to use a plane, boat or bus for a special trip

ex.en: The charter sets out the rights of all members.
ex.zh: 憲章載明了所有成員的權利。

ex.en: We took a charter flight to Okinawa.
ex.zh: 我們搭包機去沖繩。

charter.en: an official document that states rights or rules, or a plane rented for a special trip

cheque.zh: 支票（英式拼法，美式為 check）

ex.en: I haven't got any cash. Can I write a cheque?
ex.zh: 我沒帶現金，可以開支票嗎？

ex.en: Cheques are made of paper.
ex.zh: 支票是用紙做的。

ex.en: The cheque bounced because his account was empty.
ex.zh: 因為他帳戶沒錢，那張支票跳票了。

cheque.en: a printed paper that you sign to tell a bank to pay money

ex.en: The accident caused traffic chaos.
ex.zh: 那場車禍造成交通大亂。

ex.en: The world is in chaos.
ex.zh: 世界陷入一片混亂。

ex.en: The office was in chaos after the system crashed.
ex.zh: 系統當機後，辦公室一片混亂。

chaos.en: a situation with no order where everything is confused

ex.en: That boy threw a chunk of stone.
ex.zh: 那個男孩丟了一塊石頭。

ex.en: Cut the chicken into small chunks.
ex.zh: 把雞肉切成小塊。

chunk.en: a large thick piece of something

ex.en: Rent takes a big chunk of my salary.
ex.zh: 房租佔了我薪水的一大部分。

ex.en: We spent a large chunk of the budget on marketing.
ex.zh: 我們把一大部分預算花在行銷上。

chunk.en: a large part or amount of something

ex.en: He was caught cheating in the exam.
ex.zh: 他考試作弊被抓到。

ex.en: It is wrong to cheat at cards.
ex.zh: 玩牌作弊是不對的。

ex.en: During the exam, Tom cheated off Mary.
ex.zh: 考試時，湯姆抄了瑪麗的答案。

cheat.en: to do something unfair or dishonest to win or pass

ex.en: Never did I dream that George would cheat me.
ex.zh: 我做夢也沒想到喬治會騙我。

ex.en: The man cheated the old woman out of her money.
ex.zh: 那個男人騙走了老太太的錢。

cheat.en: to trick someone in order to get money or an advantage

ex.en: I found out where to buy fruit cheaply.
ex.zh: 我找到可以便宜買水果的地方了。

ex.en: You can travel cheaply in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 在東南亞可以很省錢地旅行。

ex.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.
ex.zh: 我不相信那孩子是自己一個人來東京的。

ex.en: I'll look after your child while you are away.
ex.zh: 你不在的時候，我會照顧你的孩子。

ex.en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
ex.zh: 那位醫生是兒童疾病的權威。

child.en: a young person who is not yet an adult

ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
ex.zh: 如果你們不能生孩子，還可以領養。

ex.en: They have three children.
ex.zh: 他們有三個孩子。

child.en: a person's son or daughter of any age

ex.en: I chose this topic because I think it's interesting.
ex.zh: 我選這個主題是因為我覺得它很有趣。

ex.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
ex.zh: 選一張合適的衛星影像當底圖。

ex.en: I had the good fortune to be chosen.
ex.zh: 我很幸運地被選中了。

choose.en: to pick one thing or person from several

ex.en: Many people choose to work from home.
ex.zh: 許多人選擇在家工作。

ex.en: She chose not to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 她決定不出席會議。

choose.en: to decide to do something because you want to

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高利息。

ex.en: The hotel charges 20 dollars for parking.
ex.zh: 飯店停車收費二十美元。

charge.en: to ask someone to pay an amount of money

ex.en: There is no charge for delivery.
ex.zh: 運送不收費。

ex.en: Is there an extra charge for breakfast?
ex.zh: 早餐要另外收費嗎？

charge.en: the amount of money you have to pay for something

ex.en: I'd like a phone that supports fast charging.
ex.zh: 我想要支援快充的手機。

ex.en: I need to charge my phone.
ex.zh: 我需要幫手機充電。

charge.en: to put electricity into a battery

ex.en: Who is in charge of this project?
ex.zh: 這個專案由誰負責？

ex.en: Amy is in charge while the manager is away.
ex.zh: 經理不在時由艾咪負責。

charge.en: having control of a person, group or job

ex.en: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.
ex.zh: 他因搶劫罪入獄。

ex.en: She wishes to press charges.
ex.zh: 她想要提出告訴。

charge.en: an official claim that someone has done something against the law

ex.en: I don't think we'd have any chance of winning.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們沒有任何贏的機會。

ex.en: This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
ex.zh: 這則醜聞很可能會毀了你當選的機會。

ex.en: Thank you for giving me this chance.
ex.zh: 謝謝你給我這個機會。

chance.en: a time when it is possible to do something

ex.en: There is little chance of my meeting him again.
ex.zh: 我再見到他的可能性很小。

ex.en: What are the chances we'll have a white Christmas?
ex.zh: 聖誕節下雪的機率有多大？

ex.en: The chances are he's already heard the news.
ex.zh: 他很可能已經聽說這個消息了。

chance.en: how likely it is that something will happen

ex.en: I ran into my aunt by chance in Europe.
ex.zh: 我在歐洲偶然碰到我阿姨。

ex.en: We met by chance at the airport.
ex.zh: 我們在機場巧遇。

ex.en: You should be careful in your choice of friends.
ex.zh: 你選擇朋友時要小心。

ex.en: Why is judo the best choice for your child?
ex.zh: 為什麼柔道是你孩子的最佳選擇？

ex.en: Could you tell me what my choices are?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我有哪些選擇嗎？

choice.en: the act of picking, or one of the things you can pick

choice.zh: have no choice but to：不得不、只好

ex.en: There was no choice but to sit and wait.
ex.zh: 只好坐下來等。

ex.en: We had no choice but to cancel the trip.
ex.zh: 我們不得不取消旅行。

choice.en: to have only one thing you can do

ex.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
ex.zh: 請檢查使用者名稱和密碼有沒有打錯。

ex.en: Check the tools and see if anything is missing.
ex.zh: 檢查一下工具，看看有沒有少什麼。

ex.en: Two men are checking on what's wrong with the car.
ex.zh: 兩個男人在檢查車子哪裡有問題。

check.en: to look at something to make sure it is right or safe

ex.en: Before you can board the plane, you'll have to go through airport security checks.
ex.zh: 登機前你得通過機場安檢。

ex.en: The mechanic did a safety check on the car.
ex.zh: 技師對車子做了安全檢查。

check.en: an act of looking at something to make sure it is right or safe

ex.en: Could we have the check, please?
ex.zh: 可以給我們帳單嗎？

ex.en: I paid the rent by check.
ex.zh: 我用支票付房租。

check.en: a bill you pay in a restaurant, or a paper that tells a bank to pay money

check.zh: check in / out：辦理入住、登機報到／退房

ex.en: We checked in at the hotel at three.
ex.zh: 我們三點在飯店辦理入住。

ex.en: What time do we need to check out?
ex.zh: 我們幾點要退房？

check.en: to arrive and register at a hotel or airport, or to leave a hotel

ex.en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
ex.zh: 他是個性格堅強、穩重又可靠的人。

ex.en: Honesty is an important part of his character.
ex.zh: 誠實是他品格中重要的一部分。

character.en: the qualities that make up a person's nature

ex.en: Who is your favorite character in the movie?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡電影裡的哪個角色？

ex.en: The main character is a young doctor.
ex.zh: 主角是一位年輕醫生。

character.en: a person in a story, film or play

ex.en: These Chinese characters are not too difficult for us.
ex.zh: 這些漢字對我們來說不太難。

ex.en: Does anyone know how to pronounce this character?
ex.zh: 有人知道這個字怎麼唸嗎？

ex.en: Your password must be at least eight characters long.
ex.zh: 你的密碼至少要八個字元。

character.en: a written letter, number or symbol

ex.en: The old church by the lake is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 湖邊那座老教堂很漂亮。

ex.en: There are two churches in this street.
ex.zh: 這條街上有兩座教堂。

ex.en: The church is at the foot of a mountain.
ex.zh: 教堂位於山腳下。

church.en: a building where Christians pray, or a group of Christians

ex.en: I don't get enough challenge in this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作對我來說挑戰不夠。

ex.en: She said she enjoyed the challenge.
ex.zh: 她說她很享受那個挑戰。

ex.en: I'm captivated by the challenges of translation.
ex.zh: 翻譯的挑戰讓我著迷。

challenge.en: something new and difficult that tests your ability

ex.en: Tom likes challenging himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆喜歡挑戰自己。

ex.en: She challenged me to a game of chess.
ex.zh: 她向我挑戰下一盤棋。

challenge.en: to invite someone to a contest or test of ability

ex.en: Nobody dared to challenge the manager's decision.
ex.zh: 沒人敢質疑經理的決定。

ex.en: Several people challenged his claim.
ex.zh: 好幾個人質疑他的說法。

challenge.en: to say that you do not think something is right or fair

ex.en: How many chairs do you have around your table?
ex.zh: 你家餐桌旁有幾張椅子？

ex.en: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
ex.zh: 請把那張椅子移開，它擋到路了。

ex.en: Tom carried the chairs to the next room.
ex.zh: 湯姆把椅子搬到隔壁房間。

chair.en: a seat for one person with a back

ex.en: She is the chair of the board.
ex.zh: 她是董事會主席。

ex.en: Please address your questions to the chair.
ex.zh: 請向主席提問。

chair.en: the person who leads a meeting or an organization

ex.en: Who will chair the meeting tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天的會議由誰主持？

ex.en: My manager chaired the committee for two years.
ex.zh: 我的經理擔任委員會主席兩年。

chief.zh: 主要的；首席的、最高階的

ex.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
ex.zh: 我認識了那位執行長。

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was bad weather.
ex.zh: 延誤的主要原因是天候不佳。

ex.en: She was promoted to chief financial officer.
ex.zh: 她被升為財務長。

chief.en: most important or highest in rank

ex.en: He is the chief of my department.
ex.zh: 他是我們部門的主管。

ex.en: The police chief spoke to reporters.
ex.zh: 警察局長對記者發表談話。

chief.en: the person who leads or is in charge of a group

ex.en: Let's begin with the first chapter.
ex.zh: 我們從第一章開始吧。

ex.en: We will deal with this problem in Chapter Three.
ex.zh: 我們會在第三章討論這個問題。

ex.en: This chapter is the heart of the novel.
ex.zh: 這一章是整部小說的核心。

chapter.en: one of the main parts of a book

ex.en: She works for a large hotel chain.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型連鎖飯店工作。

ex.en: The coffee chain plans to open 50 new stores.
ex.zh: 這家連鎖咖啡店計畫開五十家新店。

chain.en: a group of shops or hotels owned by the same company

ex.en: She wore a gold chain around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上戴著一條金項鍊。

ex.en: The chain came off my bike again.
ex.zh: 我的腳踏車又掉鏈了。

chain.en: a line of metal rings joined together

ex.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
ex.zh: 我們想和一家阿爾及利亞的供應商建立新的供應鏈。

ex.en: A chain of events led to the accident.
ex.zh: 一連串的事件導致了這場意外。

chain.en: a series of connected things or events

ex.en: What is on Channel 10?
ex.zh: 第十台在播什麼節目？

ex.en: Start your own YouTube channel.
ex.zh: 開設你自己的 YouTube 頻道吧。

ex.en: You can just switch channels.
ex.zh: 你轉台就好了啊。

channel.en: a television station or a service that shows programmes

ex.en: Please send all requests through the proper channels.
ex.zh: 所有申請請透過正式管道提出。

ex.en: Social media is an important sales channel.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是重要的銷售管道。

channel.en: a way of communicating or getting something done

channel.zh: 把（精力、資金）投入、引導到

ex.en: She channeled her energy into her work.
ex.zh: 她把精力投入到工作上。

ex.en: We should channel more money into research.
ex.zh: 我們應該把更多資金投入研究。

channel.en: to direct energy or money towards a particular use

ex.en: The weather here has its own unique characteristics.
ex.zh: 這裡的天氣有獨特的特色。

ex.en: Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
ex.zh: 豬和人類有某些共同的特徵。

ex.en: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
ex.zh: 這種新型都市生活有什麼特色？

characteristic.en: a quality that is typical of a person or thing

ex.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
ex.zh: 極光是極地特有的現象。

ex.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
ex.zh: 我憑著一貫的堅持克服了困難。

characteristic.en: typical of a particular person, thing or place

ex.en: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
ex.zh: 這個垃圾袋不含任何有害化學物質。

ex.en: Wear gloves when handling chemicals.
ex.zh: 處理化學藥品時要戴手套。

chemical.en: a substance made by or used in chemistry

ex.en: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
ex.zh: 把水加熱不會改變它的化學成分。

ex.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
ex.zh: 化學工廠一著火就爆炸了。

chemical.en: relating to chemistry or the substances used in it

ex.en: She was elected chairman of the committee.
ex.zh: 她當選為委員會主席。

ex.en: He's the chairman of the committee.
ex.zh: 他是委員會主席。

ex.en: The chairman of the board will speak at the meeting.
ex.zh: 董事長將在會議上致詞。

chairman.en: a person who leads a meeting or a company's board

ex.en: This photo takes me back to my childhood.
ex.zh: 這張照片讓我回到了童年。

ex.en: That song always reminds me of my childhood.
ex.zh: 那首歌總讓我想起童年。

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想成為糕點師。

childhood.en: the time of life when you are a child

ex.en: Taiwan is famous for making computer chips.
ex.zh: 台灣以生產電腦晶片聞名。

ex.en: The new phone uses a faster chip.
ex.zh: 新手機使用了更快的晶片。

chip.en: a very small piece of material with electronic parts, used in computers

ex.en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
ex.zh: 我不該把一整包洋芋片吃完的。

ex.en: There was a single potato chip on each plate.
ex.zh: 每個盤子上都有一片洋芋片。

chip.en: a thin crisp slice of potato, or a small piece of food

ex.en: The chip in Yanni's windshield became a huge crack.
ex.zh: 雅尼擋風玻璃上的小缺口變成了一道大裂縫。

ex.en: There's a chip in this cup.
ex.zh: 這個杯子有個缺口。

chip.en: a small place where a small piece has broken off something

ex.en: We all chipped in to buy Tom a birthday present.
ex.zh: 我們大家湊錢買了一份生日禮物給湯姆。

ex.en: Everyone chipped in to help clean the office.
ex.zh: 大家都出了一份力幫忙打掃辦公室。

chip.en: to give some money or help together with other people

ex.en: How would you characterize your management style?
ex.zh: 你會怎麼形容你的管理風格？

ex.en: The report characterizes the market as stable.
ex.zh: 這份報告將市場形容為穩定。

characterize.en: to describe the qualities of someone or something

ex.en: The region is characterized by hot summers.
ex.zh: 這個地區的特色是夏天炎熱。

ex.en: His work is characterized by attention to detail.
ex.zh: 他的工作特色是注重細節。

characterize.en: to be a typical feature of something

ex.en: We have two dogs, three cats, and six chickens.
ex.zh: 我們養了兩隻狗、三隻貓和六隻雞。

ex.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
ex.zh: 母雞孵蛋，孵出小雞。

chicken.en: a bird kept on farms for its eggs and meat

ex.en: I'll have the grilled chicken, please.
ex.zh: 我要烤雞，謝謝。

ex.en: Chicken is cheaper than beef.
ex.zh: 雞肉比牛肉便宜。

chicken.en: the meat of a farm bird that lays eggs, eaten as food

ex.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
ex.zh: 湯姆把一半的薪水捐給他最喜歡的慈善機構。

ex.en: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.
ex.zh: 每當我拿到一大筆錢，就會捐一部分給慈善機構。

ex.en: Tom regularly donates money to charity.
ex.zh: 湯姆經常捐錢給慈善機構。

charity.en: an organization that collects money to help people in need

ex.en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
ex.zh: 當地企業正在聯手推動一項慈善活動。

ex.en: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
ex.zh: 這世界缺少的是公義，而不是施捨。

charity.en: the act of giving help or money to people in need

ex.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
ex.zh: 這間老農舍有它獨特的魅力。

ex.en: He had a certain charm.
ex.zh: 他有一種魅力。

ex.en: Her charm is beyond description.
ex.zh: 她的魅力難以言喻。

charm.en: a pleasing quality that attracts people

ex.en: The singer charmed the audience with her voice.
ex.zh: 那位歌手用歌聲迷住了觀眾。

ex.en: He charmed everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 他在派對上讓每個人都對他很有好感。

charm.en: to please someone and make them like you

ex.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
ex.zh: 大家都很想知道前冠軍後來怎麼了。

ex.en: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?
ex.zh: 世界冠軍只能有一個。問題是：會是誰呢？

champion.en: the person or team that has won a competition

ex.en: The mayor championed the new park project.
ex.zh: 市長大力支持新公園計畫。

ex.en: She champions equal pay for women.
ex.zh: 她倡導女性同酬。

champion.en: to strongly support a person or an idea

ex.en: I have a pain in my chest.
ex.zh: 我胸口痛。

ex.en: He felt a tightness in his chest.
ex.zh: 他覺得胸口很悶。

chest.en: the front part of the body between the neck and the stomach

ex.en: Tom utilized some wooden chests as chairs.
ex.zh: 湯姆把幾個木箱當椅子用。

ex.en: This chest has old clothes in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子裡有一些舊衣服。

chest.en: a large strong box used to store things

chest.zh: get … off one's chest：把心事說出來

ex.en: I just need to get something off my chest.
ex.zh: 我只是想把心裡的話說出來。

ex.en: You'll feel better if you get it off your chest.
ex.zh: 把心事說出來你會覺得好過一點。

chest.en: to tell someone about a problem that has been worrying you

ex.en: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.
ex.zh: 城堡最隱密的房間裡，藏著世上最珍貴的寶物——《真理之書》。

ex.en: The meeting was held in the council chamber.
ex.zh: 會議在議事廳舉行。

chamber.en: a room, especially one used for a special purpose

ex.en: She is a member of the local chamber of commerce.
ex.zh: 她是當地商會的會員。

ex.en: The Chamber of Commerce organized a business fair.
ex.zh: 商會舉辦了一場商展。

chamber.en: a group of local business people who work together to help trade

ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: Don't you know cheese is made from milk?
ex.zh: 你不知道起司是用牛奶做的嗎？

ex.en: The store sells foodstuffs, such as butter, cheese, and sugar.
ex.zh: 這家店賣奶油、起司和砂糖之類的食品。

cheese.en: a food made from milk that can be soft or hard

ex.en: Life is like a box of chocolates.
ex.zh: 人生就像一盒巧克力。

ex.en: The more chocolate you eat, the fatter you'll get.
ex.zh: 你吃越多巧克力就會越胖。

ex.en: He ate a box of chocolates.
ex.zh: 他吃了一盒巧克力。

chocolate.en: a sweet brown food made from cocoa

ex.en: I competed with him for the championship.
ex.zh: 我和他爭奪冠軍。

ex.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
ex.zh: 經過多年的艱苦訓練，她終於突破自我，贏得冠軍。

ex.en: The world championship will be held in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 世界錦標賽將在東京舉行。

championship.en: a competition to decide the best player or team, or the title of winner

ex.en: The cat chased the mouse around the house.
ex.zh: 貓在屋子裡追著老鼠跑。

ex.en: The dog chased the rabbit.
ex.zh: 狗在追兔子。

chase.en: to run after someone or something to catch them

ex.en: She moved to Taipei to chase her dreams.
ex.zh: 她搬到台北追求夢想。

ex.en: Don't chase every new trend.
ex.zh: 不要盲目追逐每個新潮流。

chase.en: to try hard to get something you want

ex.en: The movie ends with an exciting car chase.
ex.zh: 電影以一場刺激的飛車追逐結尾。

ex.en: After a long chase, the police caught the thief.
ex.zh: 經過一番追捕，警察抓到了小偷。

chase.en: the act of running after someone or something to catch them

ex.en: He gave her a peck on the cheek.
ex.zh: 他在她臉頰上輕輕親了一下。

ex.en: Tom gave Mary a kiss on both cheeks.
ex.zh: 湯姆親了瑪麗的兩頰。

ex.en: Tom has a scar on his cheek.
ex.zh: 湯姆的臉頰上有一道疤。

cheek.en: the soft part on each side of the face below the eye

ex.en: The novel has excellent characterization.
ex.zh: 這部小說的人物塑造很出色。

ex.en: Good characterization makes a story believable.
ex.zh: 好的人物塑造讓故事更可信。

characterization.en: the way a writer shows the nature of people in a story

ex.en: I don't agree with his characterization of the problem.
ex.zh: 我不同意他對這個問題的描述。

ex.en: Her characterization of the meeting was accurate.
ex.zh: 她對會議的描述很準確。

characterization.en: a description of the qualities of a person or thing

ex.en: Many cancer patients lose their hair because of the chemotherapy.
ex.zh: 很多癌症病人因為化療而掉髮。

ex.en: She is undergoing chemotherapy for breast cancer.
ex.zh: 她正在接受乳癌的化療。

chemotherapy.en: a treatment for cancer that uses strong drugs

ex.en: If you like, I will teach you to play chess.
ex.zh: 你想學的話，我可以教你下西洋棋。

ex.en: You're a better chess player than I am.
ex.zh: 你西洋棋下得比我好。

ex.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
ex.zh: 他在西洋棋比賽中拿下了冠軍。

chess.en: a board game for two players with sixteen pieces each

ex.en: Sodium chloride is the chemical name for table salt.
ex.zh: 氯化鈉是食鹽的化學名稱。

ex.en: The water was tested for chloride levels.
ex.zh: 這些水做了氯化物含量檢測。

chloride.en: a chemical that contains a poisonous green gas joined to another element

ex.en: Dogs have 39 pairs of chromosomes.
ex.zh: 狗有 39 對染色體。

ex.en: Each chromosome carries thousands of genes.
ex.zh: 每條染色體都帶有數千個基因。

chromosome.en: a part of a cell that carries the information that decides how a living thing grows

ex.en: The chairwoman opened the meeting at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 女主席在九點宣布會議開始。

ex.en: She was elected chairwoman of the board last year.
ex.zh: 她去年獲選為董事長。

chairwoman.en: a woman who leads a meeting or a company's board

check-in.zh: （機場、飯店的）報到、登記入住手續

ex.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
ex.zh: 聯合航空的報到櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: Hotel check-in begins at 3 p.m.
ex.zh: 飯店入住登記從下午三點開始。

ex.en: Online check-in opens 24 hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 線上報到在起飛前 24 小時開放。

check-in.en: the place or process where you register when you arrive at an airport or hotel

check-in.zh: （與主管、同事的）簡短進度確認

ex.en: Let's have a quick check-in every Monday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每週一早上簡短確認一下進度吧。

ex.en: My manager scheduled a weekly check-in with me.
ex.zh: 我的主管安排每週跟我做一次進度確認。

check-in.en: a short talk to find out how work or a person is doing

ex.en: We sang, danced and chatted after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們唱歌、跳舞、聊天。

ex.en: Just now I was chatting with my parents.
ex.zh: 剛才我在和我爸媽閒聊。

ex.en: Bob is very timid and blushes when chatting with girls.
ex.zh: 鮑伯非常膽小，和女生聊天時會臉紅。

chat.en: to talk with someone in a friendly, relaxed way

ex.en: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
ex.zh: 湯姆，我想跟你聊聊。

ex.en: Nancy is having a chat with her friends.
ex.zh: 南西正在跟朋友聊天。

ex.en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
ex.zh: 你們有沒有比較便宜的房間？

ex.en: Would you know a cheap hotel in the near?
ex.zh: 您知道附近有便宜的旅館嗎？

ex.en: If I buy more, can I get them cheaper?
ex.zh: 我多買一些，可以便宜點嗎？

cheap.zh: 廉價的、品質差的；小氣的

ex.en: The bag looks cheap and won't last long.
ex.zh: 這個包看起來很廉價，用不久。

ex.en: Don't be so cheap. Leave a tip.
ex.zh: 別那麼小氣，給點小費吧。

cheap.en: low in quality, or not willing to spend or give money

ex.en: Here's your change. Have a nice day.
ex.zh: 這是找您的錢，祝您有美好的一天。

ex.en: Do you have change for a hundred?
ex.zh: 你有一百元的零錢可以換嗎？

change.en: small coins, or the money given back when you pay too much

ex.en: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 不管發生什麼事，我都不會改變主意。

ex.en: The room looks different after I've changed the curtains.
ex.zh: 我換了窗簾之後，房間看起來不一樣了。

ex.en: In ten years our town will change a lot.
ex.zh: 十年後，我們的城市會改變很多。

change.en: to become different, or to replace one thing with another

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多的改變。

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年我們經歷了很多變化。

ex.en: She suffers from chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 她有慢性背痛。

ex.en: The city has a chronic shortage of housing.
ex.zh: 這座城市長期住房不足。

chronic.en: lasting for a long time or happening again and again

ex.en: The doctor was giving a patient a checkup.
ex.zh: 醫生正在幫一位病人做健康檢查。

ex.en: You should get a checkup once a year.
ex.zh: 你應該每年做一次健康檢查。

checkup.en: a medical examination to see if you are healthy

ex.en: It's a little chilly in here.
ex.zh: 這裡有點冷。

ex.en: It's a chilly morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上冷颼颼的。

chilly.en: rather cold in an unpleasant way

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻一起分擔家事。

ex.en: My kids help with chores like washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我的孩子會幫忙洗碗之類的家事。

chore.en: a small job that must be done regularly, especially at home

ex.en: She sings in the school chorus every Friday.
ex.zh: 她每週五都參加學校合唱團的演唱。

ex.en: The chorus performed songs from the opera.
ex.zh: 合唱隊演唱了那齣歌劇中的曲目。

chorus.en: a large group of people who sing together

ex.en: Are you still in the choir?
ex.zh: 你還在合唱團裡面嗎？

ex.en: The church choir practices every Wednesday evening.
ex.zh: 教會的唱詩班每週三晚上練習。

choir.en: a group of people who sing together, often in a church

ex.en: Please bring me two pieces of chalk.
ex.zh: 給我拿兩根粉筆來，謝謝。

ex.en: Take this piece of chalk and write on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 拿起這支粉筆，在黑板上寫字。

ex.en: Give me a piece of chalk.
ex.zh: 給我一段粉筆。

chalk.en: a soft white stick used for writing on a board

ex.en: The teacher asked us to make a chronology of the war.
ex.zh: 老師要我們製作這場戰爭的年表。

ex.en: The chronology of the events is still unclear.
ex.zh: 這些事件發生的先後順序至今仍不清楚。

chronology.en: a list of events in the order in which they happened

ex.en: She looked chic in her simple black dress.
ex.zh: 她穿著簡單的黑色洋裝，看起來時髦又別緻。

ex.en: They opened a chic little café near the station.
ex.zh: 他們在車站附近開了一家別緻的小咖啡館。

chic.en: fashionable in a simple and stylish way

ex.en: She is a charming woman.
ex.zh: 她是個有魅力的女性。

ex.en: You look very charming today.
ex.zh: 今天你看起來很迷人啊。

ex.en: She never wears makeup, but she always looks very charming.
ex.zh: 她從不化妝, 但總是看起來很迷人。

ex.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
ex.zh: 她開朗的個性使我覺得快樂。

ex.en: She's always been a very cheerful person.
ex.zh: 她是一直是個很歡快的人

ex.en: He is not the cheerful man he was.
ex.zh: 他已經不再是以前那個快樂的男孩了。

ex.en: He was listening with his chin resting on his hand.
ex.zh: 他用手撐著下巴聽著。

ex.en: She slapped me on the chin.
ex.zh: 她打了我的下巴。

ex.en: The child fell off his bike and cut his chin.
ex.zh: 那個孩子從腳踏車上摔下來，下巴割傷了。

chin.en: the part of the face below the mouth

ex.en: She took classes to prepare for childbirth.
ex.zh: 她去上課為生產做準備。

ex.en: Childbirth can be painful, but doctors can help reduce the pain.
ex.zh: 生產可能很痛，但醫生可以幫忙減輕疼痛。

ex.en: Her mother nearly died in childbirth.
ex.zh: 她媽媽生產時差點喪命。

childbirth.en: the process of a woman giving birth to a baby

ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
ex.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你總能領養。

ex.en: This is a good book for children to read.
ex.zh: 這是一本適合兒童閱讀的好書。

ex.en: You should set a good example to your children.
ex.zh: 你應該為你的孩子們樹立好榜樣。

children.en: young people who are not yet adults

ex.en: Everyone raised their glasses and shouted, "Cheers!"
ex.zh: 大家舉起酒杯，大喊：「乾杯！」

ex.en: Cheers to our new neighbors and many happy years together!
ex.zh: 敬我們的新鄰居，祝大家多年相處愉快，乾杯！

cheers.en: said before drinking, to wish people good health

ex.en: "Here's your coffee." "Cheers, mate!"
ex.zh: 「這是你的咖啡。」「謝啦，老兄！」

ex.en: Cheers for the help yesterday; I couldn't have moved the sofa alone.
ex.zh: 謝謝你昨天幫忙，我自己一個人根本搬不動沙發。

cheers.en: a casual way in British English to say thank you or goodbye

ex.en: My little sister is a real chatterbox at dinner.
ex.zh: 我妹妹在晚餐時真是個話匣子。

ex.en: The teacher moved the two chatterboxes to different seats.
ex.zh: 老師把那兩個愛講話的學生調到不同的座位。

chatterbox.en: a person who talks a lot

ex.en: Tom is a famous chef.
ex.zh: 湯姆是有名的廚師。

ex.en: We have a very good chef.
ex.zh: 我們有一位非常好的廚師。

ex.en: She used to be a part time chef, then she became full time.
ex.zh: 她以前是兼職廚師，後來做了全職。

chef.en: a professional cook, especially the main one in a restaurant

ex.en: Tom is a chauffeur.
ex.zh: 湯姆是專職司機。

ex.en: Her chauffeur waited outside the hotel until the meeting ended.
ex.zh: 會議結束前，她的司機一直在飯店外等候。

chauffeur.en: a person whose job is to drive someone else's car

ex.en: My cholesterol is high.
ex.zh: 我的膽固醇偏高。

ex.en: The nutrition label lists the amount of cholesterol per serving.
ex.zh: 營養標示列出每份所含的膽固醇量。

cholesterol.en: a fatty substance in the blood that can cause heart problems if there is too much

ex.en: Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
ex.zh: 蘇在皇家飯店辦理了入住。

ex.en: He checked in at a good hotel.
ex.zh: 他入住了一間很好的旅館。

ex.en: Can I leave my bags with you until I come to check in?
ex.zh: 在我辦理入住之前，可以先把行李寄放在你這裡嗎？

check in.en: to arrive at a hotel and register

ex.en: You should check in at least two hours before an international flight.
ex.zh: 搭國際航班至少要提前兩小時辦理報到。

ex.en: We checked in online, so we only had to drop off our bags.
ex.zh: 我們已經線上報到，所以只需要托運行李。

check in.en: to show your ticket at an airport before a flight

ex.en: I'm going to check out at eight.
ex.zh: 我會在八點退房。

ex.en: I'd like to check out right now.
ex.zh: 我想現在退房。

check out.en: to leave a hotel after paying

ex.en: Recently someone told me about a language website, tatoeba.org, which I will definitely check out.
ex.zh: 最近有人告訴我一個語言網站，tatoeba.org。我一定要看看。

ex.en: You should check out the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你應該去看看車站附近那家新咖啡店。

check out.en: to look at something to see if it is interesting or good

ex.en: If you're worried, go for an endoscopy to have it checked out.
ex.zh: 要是不放心的話，你去做個胃鏡查一查。

ex.en: Get your car checked out before the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行前把車子送去檢查一下。

check out.en: to examine something to make sure it is safe or correct

ex.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
ex.zh: 工作流程如下圖所示。

ex.en: This chart shows our sales over the past year.
ex.zh: 這張圖表顯示我們過去一年的銷售狀況。

chart.en: a drawing or table that shows information clearly

ex.en: Her new song is at the top of the charts.
ex.zh: 她的新歌登上排行榜冠軍。

ex.en: The album stayed on the charts for months.
ex.zh: 這張專輯在排行榜上待了好幾個月。

chart.en: a list of the most popular songs or albums

ex.en: They got married in a small chapel by the sea.
ex.zh: 他們在海邊的一座小教堂結婚。

ex.en: The old school has a quiet chapel for morning prayers.
ex.zh: 那所老學校有一間安靜的小禮拜堂供晨禱使用。

ex.en: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the wedding.
ex.zh: 他們開了一瓶香檳來慶祝婚禮。

ex.en: We raised our glasses of champagne at midnight on New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 新年前夕的午夜，我們舉起香檳杯。

ex.en: He is a friendly chap who always helps his neighbors.
ex.zh: 他是個友善的傢伙，總是幫助鄰居。

ex.en: Who is that tall chap standing by the door?
ex.zh: 站在門邊的那個高個子是誰？

ex.en: Chop the onions into small pieces.
ex.zh: 把洋蔥切成小塊。

ex.en: He chopped some wood for the fire.
ex.zh: 他劈了一些柴來生火。

ex.en: She is chopping vegetables for the soup.
ex.zh: 她正在切湯用的蔬菜。

ex.en: We had pork chops for dinner last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚晚餐吃了豬排。

ex.en: He ordered a lamb chop with rice.
ex.zh: 他點了一份羊排配飯。

ex.en: There was a chill in the air this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上空氣中帶著寒意。

ex.en: I felt a chill when I walked into the room.
ex.zh: 我走進房間時感到一陣寒意。

ex.en: Chill the drinks before the guests arrive.
ex.zh: 客人到之前先把飲料冰好。

ex.en: Let the dough chill for an hour.
ex.zh: 讓麵團冷藏一個小時。

ex.en: We just chilled at home all weekend.
ex.zh: 我們整個週末都在家放鬆。

ex.en: Let's chill by the lake after work.
ex.zh: 下班後我們去湖邊放鬆一下吧。

ex.en: Chew your food slowly before you swallow.
ex.zh: 吞下去之前要慢慢咀嚼食物。

ex.en: The dog chewed my shoe again.
ex.zh: 狗又咬了我的鞋子。

ex.en: He likes to chew gum while studying.
ex.zh: 他唸書時喜歡嚼口香糖。

ex.en: The dog loves this toy for a good chew.
ex.zh: 狗很喜歡這個可以拿來啃咬的玩具。

ex.en: Give the candy a long chew.
ex.zh: 這顆糖要嚼很久。

ex.en: Warm summers characterise the climate of this region.
ex.zh: 炎熱的夏天是這個地區氣候的特色。

ex.en: The author characterises him as a quiet man.
ex.zh: 作者把他描寫成一個安靜的人。

challenging.zh: 具挑戰性的、困難但有趣的

ex.en: Learning a new language can be challenging but fun.
ex.zh: 學習一種新語言可能很有挑戰性，但也很有趣。

ex.en: This is a challenging job that requires a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 這是一份需要很多耐心的有挑戰性的工作。

ex.en: Charles is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 查爾斯是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Charles reads a book before bed every night.
ex.zh: 查爾斯每天睡前都會看書。

ex.en: I sat next to Charles during the meeting.

chatter.zh: 喋喋不休地聊；嘰嘰喳喳

ex.en: The students chatter during the break.
ex.zh: 學生們在下課時間嘰嘰喳喳地聊天。

ex.en: Birds chattered in the trees all morning.
ex.zh: 鳥兒整個早上都在樹上嘰嘰喳喳。

ex.en: I could hear the chatter of children in the yard.
ex.zh: 我聽得到院子裡孩子們的嘰嘰喳喳聲。

ex.en: The chatter in the café made it hard to study.
ex.zh: 咖啡廳裡的嘈雜談話聲讓人很難念書。

ex.en: His teeth chattered in the freezing wind.
ex.zh: 他的牙齒在刺骨的寒風中打顫。

ex.en: My teeth were chattering after the cold swim.
ex.zh: 冷水游泳後我的牙齒一直在打顫。

ex.en: The kids slid down the water chute and splashed into the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子們從水上滑道滑下去，濺起水花落入泳池。

ex.en: Put the garbage down the chute at the end of the hall.
ex.zh: 把垃圾丟進走廊盡頭的垃圾滑槽。

ex.en: His chute opened and he floated slowly to the ground.
ex.zh: 他的降落傘打開了，他慢慢飄落到地面。

ex.en: The skydiver checked her chute before the jump.
ex.zh: 跳傘員在跳之前檢查了她的降落傘。

ex.en: The school has a famous choral group.
ex.zh: 這所學校有一個很有名的合唱團。

ex.en: We attended a choral concert at the church.
ex.zh: 我們去教堂聽了一場合唱音樂會。

ex.en: Cholera spreads through dirty drinking water.
ex.zh: 霍亂會經由不乾淨的飲用水傳播。

ex.en: Clean water systems helped stop cholera in many cities.
ex.zh: 乾淨的供水系統幫助許多城市遏止了霍亂。

ex.en: The chimpanzee used a stick to get food out of the hole.
ex.zh: 那隻黑猩猩用一根樹枝把洞裡的食物掏出來。

ex.en: We watched a baby chimpanzee play at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我們在動物園看小黑猩猩玩耍。

chi.zh: 氣（中國哲學與武術的概念）

ex.en: Tai chi teaches you to move the chi through your body.
ex.zh: 太極教你讓氣在體內流動。

ex.en: He believes that good chi comes from calm breathing.
ex.zh: 他相信好的氣來自平穩的呼吸。

ex.en: Chi is the twenty-second letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.zh: Chi 是希臘字母的第二十二個字母。

ex.en: Students use the symbol chi in a statistics test.
ex.zh: 學生在統計檢定中會用到 chi 這個符號。

ex.en: My phone is charging on the desk.
ex.zh: 我的手機正在桌上充電。

ex.en: I left the laptop charging overnight.
ex.zh: 我讓筆電充了一整晚的電。

ex.en: The restaurant is charging extra for sauce.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳醬料要額外收費。

ex.en: They are charging too much for parking.
ex.zh: 他們停車收費太貴了。

ex.en: A bull was charging toward the fence.
ex.zh: 一頭公牛正衝向圍欄。

ex.en: The children came charging down the stairs.
ex.zh: 孩子們衝下樓梯。

ex.en: The new coach has a lot of charisma and the players love him.
ex.zh: 新教練很有個人魅力，球員們都喜歡他。

ex.en: Her charisma helped her win over the crowd.
ex.zh: 她的魅力幫她贏得群眾的心。

ex.en: She has high cheekbones and bright eyes.
ex.zh: 她有高高的顴骨和明亮的眼睛。

ex.en: He fell off his bike and bruised his cheekbone.
ex.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，顴骨瘀青了。

ex.en: We bought a bottle of Chilean wine for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們買了一瓶智利葡萄酒當晚餐。

ex.en: The Chilean team arrived in Taipei yesterday.
ex.zh: 智利代表隊昨天抵達台北。

ex.en: My roommate is a Chilean who loves hiking.
ex.zh: 我的室友是個愛健行的智利人。

ex.en: Many Chileans live near the long coast.
ex.zh: 許多智利人住在長長的海岸附近。

ex.en: She poured a glass of chilled juice for each guest.
ex.zh: 她為每位客人倒了一杯冰鎮果汁。

ex.en: The chilled soup is perfect for a hot day.
ex.zh: 這道冷湯很適合炎熱的日子。

ex.en: We had a chilled evening at home watching movies.
ex.zh: 我們在家看電影，度過了悠閒的夜晚。

ex.en: He is a really chilled guy who never worries.
ex.zh: 他是個很放鬆的人，從不煩惱。

ex.en: The bike has shiny chrome handlebars.
ex.zh: 這輛腳踏車有閃亮的鍍鉻把手。

ex.en: Chrome is often used to protect metal from rust.
ex.zh: 鉻常被用來保護金屬不生鏽。

ex.en: Please list your jobs in chronological order.
ex.zh: 請按時間順序列出你的工作經歷。

ex.en: The book tells the story in chronological order.
ex.zh: 這本書按時間順序敘述故事。

ex.en: The soldier rode a chariot pulled by two horses.
ex.zh: 那位士兵乘坐由兩匹馬拉的戰車。

ex.en: The museum has a model of an ancient chariot.
ex.zh: 博物館裡有一輛古代戰車的模型。

ex.en: The old churchman gave a kind speech at the festival.
ex.zh: 那位年長的神職人員在慶典上發表了親切的講話。

ex.en: A local churchman helped organize the charity dinner.
ex.zh: 當地一位神職人員協助籌辦了慈善晚宴。

ex.en: The novel is praised for its strong characterisation.
ex.zh: 這部小說因其鮮明的角色塑造而受到讚賞。

ex.en: The teacher discussed the characterisation of the hero.
ex.zh: 老師討論了這位主角的人物刻畫。

ex.en: The mechanic checked the chassis for damage after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故後，技師檢查了底盤有沒有受損。

ex.en: A strong chassis helps keep the car stable at high speed.
ex.zh: 堅固的車架讓車子在高速行駛時保持穩定。

ex.en: Charlie Chaplin was a famous actor in silent films.
ex.zh: 查理．卓別林是默片時代的著名演員。

ex.en: We watched an old Chaplin movie in class today.
ex.zh: 我們今天在課堂上看了一部卓別林的老電影。

ex.en: He is chronically tired because he never gets enough sleep.
ex.zh: 他因為睡眠一直不足而長期疲倦。

ex.en: The hospital is chronically short of nurses.
ex.zh: 那間醫院長期缺乏護理師。

ex.en: This old photo is one of her most cherished possessions.
ex.zh: 這張舊照片是她最珍視的物品之一。

ex.en: He keeps a cherished memory of his first trip abroad.
ex.zh: 他珍藏著第一次出國旅行的美好回憶。

cherished.zh: 珍愛；懷有（cherish 的過去式）

ex.en: She cherished every moment with her grandchildren.
ex.zh: 她珍惜和孫子孫女相處的每一刻。

ex.en: He cherished the hope of seeing his family again.
ex.zh: 他懷著再見到家人的希望。

ex.en: She has a childlike love of snow and snowmen.
ex.zh: 她對雪和雪人有著孩子般的熱愛。

ex.en: His childlike curiosity makes him a great scientist.
ex.zh: 他孩子般的好奇心讓他成為出色的科學家。

ex.en: The village chandler sold candles and soap.
ex.zh: 村裡的蠟燭商賣蠟燭和肥皂。

ex.en: In the past, every town had a chandler who made candles by hand.
ex.zh: 過去每個城鎮都有一位手工製作蠟燭的蠟燭商。

ex.en: The chime of the clock told us it was noon.
ex.zh: 時鐘的鐘聲告訴我們中午了。

ex.en: A soft chime sounded when the door opened.
ex.zh: 門一打開，就響起一聲輕柔的鈴聲。

ex.en: The church bells chimed at six o'clock.
ex.zh: 教堂的鐘在六點鳴響。

ex.en: My phone chimes whenever I get a message.
ex.zh: 每次收到訊息，我的手機都會叮咚響。

ex.en: May I chime in with a quick question?
ex.zh: 我可以插個話，問個簡單的問題嗎？

ex.en: Everyone chimed in with their own ideas during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時大家都紛紛加入討論，說出自己的想法。

ex.en: Many parents struggle to afford childcare.
ex.zh: 許多父母難以負擔托兒費用。

ex.en: The company offers free childcare for its employees.
ex.zh: 這家公司為員工提供免費的托兒服務。

ex.en: He pulled out his checkbook to pay the bill.
ex.zh: 他拿出支票簿來付帳。

ex.en: My grandmother still balances her checkbook every month.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每個月仍會核對她的支票簿。

choosing.zh: 選擇；挑選（choose 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I am choosing a gift for my mother's birthday.
ex.zh: 我正在挑選送給媽媽的生日禮物。

ex.en: Choosing a major is not easy for most students.
ex.zh: 選擇主修對大多數學生來說並不容易。

ex.en: The two substances react chemically when they are mixed.
ex.zh: 這兩種物質混合時會起化學反應。

ex.en: The water was chemically treated before it was sold.
ex.zh: 這些水在販售前經過化學處理。

ex.en: The teacher chided him gently for being late.
ex.zh: 老師溫和地責備他遲到。

ex.en: She chided herself for forgetting the keys.
ex.zh: 她責怪自己忘了帶鑰匙。

ex.en: The choreographer taught the dancers a new routine.
ex.zh: 編舞家教舞者們一套新舞步。

ex.en: She works as a choreographer for a theater company.
ex.zh: 她在一個劇團擔任編舞。

ex.en: We stood at the edge of a deep chasm.
ex.zh: 我們站在一道深谷的邊緣。

ex.en: A narrow bridge crossed the chasm below the cliff.
ex.zh: 一座窄橋橫跨在懸崖下的裂谷上。

ex.en: There is a huge chasm between rich and poor in the city.
ex.zh: 這座城市的貧富差距極大。

ex.en: The argument created a chasm between the two brothers.
ex.zh: 那場爭吵讓兄弟倆之間出現了巨大的隔閡。

ex.en: The chimp at the zoo used a stick to get some food.
ex.zh: 動物園裡的黑猩猩用一根樹枝去拿食物。

ex.en: A young chimp climbed onto its mother's back.
ex.zh: 一隻小黑猩猩爬上了牠媽媽的背。

chunky.zh: 矮胖的；厚實的；有大塊料的

ex.en: The baby had chunky little legs and a big smile.
ex.zh: 這個寶寶有一雙肉嘟嘟的小腿和大大的笑容。

ex.en: She wore a chunky sweater to keep warm.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件厚實的毛衣保暖。

ex.en: I like chunky tomato sauce better than smooth sauce.
ex.zh: 比起滑順的醬汁，我更喜歡有大塊番茄的醬汁。

ex.en: We shared a slice of strawberry cheesecake after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們分著吃了一片草莓起司蛋糕。

ex.en: Her homemade cheesecake has a crunchy cookie crust.
ex.zh: 她自製的起司蛋糕有酥脆的餅乾底。

ex.en: They will christen the baby at the church on Sunday.
ex.zh: 他們星期天會在教堂為寶寶施洗並命名。

ex.en: Fans christened the young player the new star of the team.
ex.zh: 球迷把這位年輕球員稱為球隊的新星。

ex.en: The baby has chubby cheeks and a big smile.
ex.zh: 寶寶有胖嘟嘟的臉頰和大大的笑容。

ex.en: He was a chubby child but became slim later.
ex.zh: 他小時候圓滾滾的，後來變瘦了。

ex.en: She is checking the answers before handing in the test.
ex.zh: 她在交卷前正在檢查答案。

ex.en: I am checking the weather before we leave.
ex.zh: 我出發前正在確認天氣。

ex.en: He keeps his rent money in a checking account.
ex.zh: 他把房租的錢放在支票存款帳戶裡。

ex.en: A checking account is useful for paying daily bills.
ex.zh: 支票存款帳戶很適合用來付日常帳單。

ex.en: Birds began to chirp outside my window at dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明時鳥兒開始在我窗外啁啾。

ex.en: The crickets chirp all night in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天蟋蟀整夜唧唧叫。

ex.en: I woke up to the chirp of a small bird.
ex.zh: 我被小鳥的啁啾聲叫醒。

ex.en: The smoke alarm gave a short chirp when the battery was low.
ex.zh: 電池電量低時，煙霧警報器發出短短的嗶聲。

ex.en: She will choreograph the dance for the school show.
ex.zh: 她將為學校的表演編舞。

ex.en: It took weeks to choreograph the opening scene.
ex.zh: 編排開場那一幕花了好幾個星期。

ex.en: He went fishing with his old chum from school.
ex.zh: 他和學生時代的老朋友一起去釣魚。

ex.en: The two chums shared everything.
ex.zh: 這兩個好哥們什麼都分享。

ex.en: The fire charred the wooden table black.
ex.zh: 那場火把木桌燒成焦黑。

ex.en: He charred the steak by leaving it on the grill too long.
ex.zh: 他把牛排放在烤架上太久，烤焦了。

ex.en: The coach chastised the players for being late.
ex.zh: 教練責罵球員遲到。

ex.en: She chastised herself for forgetting the meeting.
ex.zh: 她責怪自己忘了開會。

ex.en: Many women delay childbearing until their thirties.
ex.zh: 許多女性把生育延到三十多歲。

ex.en: The doctor discussed the risks of childbearing.
ex.zh: 醫生談到了生育的風險。

ex.en: The choreography of the show was amazing.
ex.zh: 這場表演的編舞太驚人了。

ex.en: She studied choreography at a dance school.
ex.zh: 她在舞蹈學校學習編舞。

ex.en: The waiter gave us a cheery smile and a warm welcome.
ex.zh: 服務生對我們露出開朗的笑容並熱情歡迎。

ex.en: She left a cheery message on my phone this morning.
ex.zh: 她今天早上在我的手機留了一則愉快的訊息。

checker.zh: 西洋跳棋的棋子；跳棋遊戲

ex.en: He moved a checker across the board and won the game.
ex.zh: 他把一顆棋子走過棋盤，贏了這盤棋。

ex.en: My grandmother taught me to play checkers when I was six.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在我六歲時教我玩跳棋。

ex.en: The checker at the supermarket scanned my groceries quickly.
ex.zh: 超市的收銀員很快掃完我買的東西。

ex.en: A safety checker inspects every machine before the shift starts.
ex.zh: 安全檢查員在換班前會檢查每台機器。

ex.en: The childless couple spent their holidays traveling abroad.
ex.zh: 那對沒有孩子的夫妻都利用假期出國旅行。

ex.en: She was happy with her childless life and her many pets.
ex.zh: 她很滿意沒有孩子、養著許多寵物的生活。

ex.en: The old train chugged slowly up the hill.
ex.zh: 那列老火車嘎嚓嘎嚓地慢慢爬上山坡。

ex.en: A small boat chugs across the lake every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早上都有一艘小船突突地駛過湖面。

ex.en: We heard the steady chug of the engine in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽見遠處引擎規律的嘎嚓聲。

ex.en: The tractor started with a loud chug.
ex.zh: 拖拉機在一陣響亮的嘎嚓聲中發動了。

ex.en: The hotel charged us extra for breakfast.
ex.zh: 飯店向我們額外收了早餐的錢。

ex.en: The mechanic charged fifty dollars for the repair.
ex.zh: 修理工收了五十元的修理費。

ex.en: The man was charged with stealing a bike.
ex.zh: 那個男人被控偷了一輛腳踏車。

ex.en: Police charged him with speeding last night.
ex.zh: 警方昨晚以超速罪名起訴他。

charged.zh: 氣氛緊張的；情緒激動的

ex.en: The room was charged with tension before the results came out.
ex.zh: 結果公布前，房間裡瀰漫著緊張的氣氛。

ex.en: It was an emotionally charged speech.
ex.zh: 那是一場充滿情感的演說。

ex.en: The village chieftain welcomed the visitors with a feast.
ex.zh: 村裡的酋長以宴席歡迎訪客。

ex.en: In the legend, the chieftain led his people across the mountains.
ex.zh: 傳說中，那位首領帶領族人翻越群山。

ex.en: He used a chisel to shape the wooden beam.
ex.zh: 他用鑿子修整那根木梁。

ex.en: The sculptor held a chisel in one hand and a hammer in the other.
ex.zh: 雕刻家一手拿鑿子，一手拿槌子。

ex.en: She chiseled a name into the stone.
ex.zh: 她在石頭上鑿刻了一個名字。

ex.en: The workers chiseled away the old plaster.
ex.zh: 工人把舊的灰泥鑿掉。

ex.en: We stayed at a charming chateau in the French countryside.
ex.zh: 我們住在法國鄉間一座迷人的城堡裡。

ex.en: The old chateau is surrounded by vineyards.
ex.zh: 那座古老的城堡四周都是葡萄園。

ex.en: We rented a wooden chalet in the Alps for the ski season.
ex.zh: 我們在阿爾卑斯山租了一間木屋度過滑雪季。

ex.en: The chalet had a big fireplace and a view of the mountains.
ex.zh: 那間木屋有大壁爐，還能看到山景。

ex.en: The movie had a cheesy ending that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 這部電影的結局很老套，讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: He told a cheesy joke to break the silence.
ex.zh: 他說了一個俗氣的笑話來打破沉默。

ex.en: The kitchen smelled warm and cheesy after she baked the pasta.
ex.zh: 她烤完義大利麵後，廚房裡充滿溫暖的起司香味。

ex.en: These cheesy crackers are my favorite snack.
ex.zh: 這些起司口味的餅乾是我最愛的點心。

ex.en: Stories of chivalry often tell of knights protecting the weak.
ex.zh: 騎士精神的故事常提到騎士保護弱者。

ex.en: He opened the door for her out of old-fashioned chivalry.
ex.zh: 他出於老派的紳士風度為她開門。

ex.en: The dog is chewing on an old shoe.
ex.zh: 那隻狗正在啃一隻舊鞋子。

ex.en: Stop chewing with your mouth open.
ex.zh: 不要張著嘴巴咀嚼。

ex.en: She sat there chewing her pen while she thought.
ex.zh: 她坐在那裡一邊咬著筆一邊思考。

ex.en: These new shoes chafe my heels.
ex.zh: 這雙新鞋磨得我的腳跟很痛。

ex.en: The rope began to chafe his hands.
ex.zh: 繩子開始磨傷他的手。

ex.en: He began to chafe at the strict rules.
ex.zh: 他開始對嚴格的規定感到煩躁。

ex.en: She chafed under her boss's constant criticism.
ex.zh: 她對老闆不斷的批評感到惱火。

ex.en: Don't let the toast char in the toaster.
ex.zh: 別讓吐司在烤麵包機裡燒焦。

ex.en: The fire began to char the wooden beams.
ex.zh: 火焰開始燒焦木頭橫梁。

ex.en: The drawing was made with char from burnt wood.
ex.zh: 這幅畫是用燒過的木頭做成的炭畫的。

ex.en: A layer of char covered the old pan.
ex.zh: 舊鍋子上覆蓋著一層焦炭。

ex.en: To his chagrin, he missed the train by one minute.
ex.zh: 讓他懊惱的是，他差一分鐘沒趕上火車。

ex.en: She hid her chagrin when someone else won the prize.
ex.zh: 別人得獎時，她掩飾了自己的懊惱。

ex.en: It chagrined him to lose to a younger player.
ex.zh: 輸給較年輕的選手讓他很懊惱。

ex.en: The error chagrined the team and made them work harder.
ex.zh: 這個失誤讓團隊很懊惱，也促使他們更努力。

ex.en: I forgot my phone charger at the hotel.
ex.zh: 我把手機充電器忘在飯店了。

ex.en: Do you have a charger that fits this laptop?
ex.zh: 你有適用這台筆電的充電器嗎？

ex.en: The battery charger takes about two hours to finish.
ex.zh: 這個電池充電器大約要兩小時才充得滿。

ex.en: The knight rode his trusty charger into the field.
ex.zh: 騎士騎著他可靠的戰馬進入戰場。

ex.en: In old paintings, the charger is often shown rearing up.
ex.zh: 在古畫裡，戰馬常被畫成前蹄揚起的樣子。

ex.en: Christchurch is the largest city on New Zealand's South Island.
ex.zh: 基督城是紐西蘭南島最大的城市。

ex.en: We flew to Christchurch before driving through the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們先飛到基督城，再開車穿越山區。

ex.en: The Chechen people live mainly in the North Caucasus.
ex.zh: 車臣人主要居住在北高加索地區。

ex.en: Chechen is a language spoken in the Caucasus region.
ex.zh: 車臣語是高加索地區使用的一種語言。

ex.en: In the Middle Ages, much of Europe was part of Christendom.
ex.zh: 中世紀時，歐洲大部分地區屬於基督教世界。

ex.en: Historians write about the Church and the rulers of Christendom.
ex.zh: 歷史學家書寫教會與基督教世界統治者的歷史。

ex.en: The streets look beautiful at Christmastime.
ex.zh: 聖誕節期間，街道看起來很美。

ex.en: My family always gets together at Christmastime.
ex.zh: 我家人在聖誕節期總是會團聚。

ex.en: The nuns take a vow of chastity.
ex.zh: 修女們發誓守貞。

ex.en: In many old stories, chastity was seen as a great virtue.
ex.zh: 在許多古老的故事裡，貞潔被視為一種美德。

ex.en: Chaucer wrote The Canterbury Tales in the 14th century.
ex.zh: 喬叟在十四世紀寫下《坎特伯里故事集》。

ex.en: We read a short piece by Chaucer in English class.
ex.zh: 我們在英文課讀了喬叟的一篇短作品。

ex.en: Chad is a large country in central Africa.
ex.zh: 查德是非洲中部的一個大國。

ex.en: Lake Chad lies on the border of several countries.
ex.zh: 查德湖位於幾個國家的交界處。

ex.en: The ferry rocked on the choppy sea.
ex.zh: 渡輪在波濤洶湧的海面上搖晃。

ex.en: The water was too choppy for swimming.
ex.zh: 水面波浪太大，不適合游泳。

ex.en: His writing is choppy and hard to follow.
ex.zh: 他的文章零碎又不連貫，很難讀懂。

ex.en: The video was choppy because of the slow internet.
ex.zh: 網路太慢，影片播得斷斷續續。

ex.en: A monk served as the chronicler of the village's history.
ex.zh: 一位修士擔任這個村莊歷史的記錄者。

ex.en: The author is a careful chronicler of everyday life.
ex.zh: 這位作者是日常生活的細心記錄者。

ex.en: The chameleon changed color to match the leaf.
ex.zh: 變色龍變色以配合葉子的顏色。

ex.en: A chameleon slowly shot out its tongue to catch an insect.
ex.zh: 變色龍慢慢彈出舌頭捕捉昆蟲。

ex.en: He is a chameleon who changes his opinions to please everyone.
ex.zh: 他是個善變的人，會為了討好大家而改變意見。

ex.en: As a social chameleon, she fits in with any group.
ex.zh: 作為社交上的變色龍，她能融入任何團體。

ex.en: Add one chilli to the soup if you like it spicy.
ex.zh: 如果你喜歡吃辣，就在湯裡加一根辣椒。

ex.en: She chopped a red chilli and mixed it into the sauce.
ex.zh: 她切了一根紅辣椒拌進醬汁裡。

ex.en: She spread a red and white checkered cloth on the table.
ex.zh: 她在桌上鋪了一塊紅白格子的桌布。

ex.en: The racing flag is black and white and checkered.
ex.zh: 賽車用的旗子是黑白相間的格子旗。

checkered.zh: 起伏不定的；有不光彩過去的

ex.en: The company has a checkered history of success and failure.
ex.zh: 這家公司的歷史成敗交織、起伏不定。

ex.en: He has a checkered past, but he is trying to change.
ex.zh: 他有一段不光彩的過去，但正努力改變。

ex.en: Chromium is a hard, shiny metal.
ex.zh: 鉻是一種堅硬而有光澤的金屬。

ex.en: Stainless steel contains chromium, which helps prevent rust.
ex.zh: 不鏽鋼含有鉻，有助於防鏽。

ex.en: He melted cheddar on top of the burger.
ex.zh: 他把切達起司融在漢堡上。

ex.en: This sharp cheddar goes well with apples.
ex.zh: 這種味道濃郁的切達起司很適合配蘋果。

ex.en: The choir stood in the chancel near the altar.
ex.zh: 詩班站在靠近祭壇的內殿裡。

ex.en: A carved wooden screen separates the chancel from the rest of the church.
ex.zh: 一道雕花木屏把內殿和教堂其他部分隔開。

ex.en: She starts chemo next week and is feeling hopeful.
ex.zh: 她下週開始化療，心情抱持希望。

ex.en: The chemo made him tired, but he kept working.
ex.zh: 化療讓他很疲倦，但他仍繼續工作。

ex.en: The cheetah is the fastest land animal in the world.
ex.zh: 獵豹是世界上跑得最快的陸地動物。

ex.en: A cheetah crouched in the tall grass, watching the herd.
ex.zh: 一隻獵豹蹲伏在高草叢裡，盯著牛羚群。

ex.en: I see a chiropractor for my back pain.
ex.zh: 我因為背痛去看脊骨神經醫師。

ex.en: The chiropractor adjusted my neck and shoulders.
ex.zh: 脊骨神經醫師幫我調整了頸部和肩膀。

ex.en: The rabbit ran fast, but the chaser was faster.
ex.zh: 兔子跑得很快，但追趕的人更快。

ex.en: He is a storm chaser who photographs tornadoes every spring.
ex.zh: 他是追風暴的人，每年春天都會拍攝龍捲風。

ex.en: She wore a light chiffon scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上圍著一條輕盈的雪紡圍巾。

ex.en: The bridesmaid dresses were made of pale blue chiffon.
ex.zh: 伴娘禮服是淺藍色雪紡紗做的。

ex.en: I baked a lemon chiffon cake for my mother's birthday.
ex.zh: 我為媽媽的生日烤了一個檸檬戚風蛋糕。

ex.en: The chiffon curtains moved gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 雪紡材質的窗簾在微風中輕輕擺動。

ex.en: Any damage to the room will be chargeable to the guest.
ex.zh: 房間的任何損壞都要由住客付費。

ex.en: Phone calls from the hotel are chargeable at a higher rate.
ex.zh: 從飯店撥打的電話要以較高的費率收費。

ex.en: He is learning how to use chopsticks to eat noodles.
ex.zh: 他正在學習用筷子吃麵。

ex.en: Please don't stick your chopsticks upright in the rice.
ex.zh: 請不要把筷子直直插在飯裡。

ex.en: "Cheerio, see you tomorrow!" he called from the door.
ex.zh: 「再見，明天見！」他在門口喊道。

ex.en: The old gentleman waved and said cheerio.
ex.zh: 那位老先生揮揮手說了聲再見。

ex.en: I drank from a chipped mug because the good ones were dirty.
ex.zh: 好杯子都髒了，所以我用一個缺角的馬克杯喝水。

ex.en: She tried to hide her chipped nail polish before the meeting.
ex.zh: 她開會前想遮住剝落的指甲油。

ex.en: The old plate was chipped around the edge.
ex.zh: 那個舊盤子邊緣有缺口。

ex.en: Chemists use chromatography to separate the parts of a mixture.
ex.zh: 化學家用層析法來分離混合物的成分。

ex.en: In the lab, we used paper chromatography to separate the colors in ink.
ex.zh: 在實驗室裡，我們用紙層析法分離墨水中的顏色。

ex.en: The soldier's sleeve had two chevrons showing his rank.
ex.zh: 那名士兵的袖子上有兩個表示軍階的V形臂章。

ex.en: The floor was laid in a chevron pattern.
ex.zh: 地板鋪成了人字形的圖案。

ex.en: The road sign showed a black chevron pointing left.
ex.zh: 路標上有一個指向左邊的黑色V形符號。

ex.en: The teacher wrote the date on the chalkboard.
ex.zh: 老師把日期寫在黑板上。

ex.en: Please erase the chalkboard before class ends.
ex.zh: 下課前請把黑板擦乾淨。

ex.en: The teacher caught the cheater copying answers.
ex.zh: 老師抓到了抄答案的作弊者。

ex.en: Nobody wants to play cards with a cheater.
ex.zh: 沒有人想和愛作弊的人玩牌。

charade.zh: 猜字謎遊戲；虛假的偽裝

ex.en: We played charades at the party.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上玩比手畫腳猜字謎。

ex.en: His friendly manner was just a charade.
ex.zh: 他友善的態度只是在做表面功夫。

ex.en: He is chopping onions for the soup.
ex.zh: 他正在切洋蔥準備煮湯。

ex.en: They spent the afternoon chopping wood.
ex.zh: 他們整個下午都在劈柴。

ex.en: He used a chainsaw to cut the fallen tree into pieces.
ex.zh: 他用鏈鋸把倒下的樹鋸成幾段。

ex.en: Always wear safety glasses when you operate a chainsaw.
ex.zh: 操作鏈鋸時一定要戴護目鏡。

ex.en: The sound of a chainsaw echoed through the forest.
ex.zh: 鏈鋸的聲音在森林裡迴盪。

ex.en: The horse chomped on a carrot.
ex.zh: 那匹馬大口嚼著一根紅蘿蔔。

ex.en: Don't chomp your food with your mouth open.
ex.zh: 別張著嘴巴大聲嚼食物。

ex.en: We ate curry with mango chutney.
ex.zh: 我們吃咖哩配芒果酸辣醬。

ex.en: She made a jar of tomato chutney from the garden.
ex.zh: 她用自家園子的番茄做了一罐酸辣醬。

ex.en: She checked the door before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出門前檢查了門有沒有鎖好。

ex.en: He checked his email as soon as he woke up.
ex.zh: 他一醒來就查看電子郵件。

ex.en: He wore a blue checked shirt.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件藍色格子襯衫。

ex.en: The table was covered with a red checked cloth.
ex.zh: 桌上鋪著紅色格子桌布。

chequered.zh: 有格子花紋的；起伏不定的

ex.en: The café had a chequered floor of black and white tiles.
ex.zh: 那家咖啡館的地板鋪著黑白相間的格子磁磚。

ex.en: The company has a chequered history, with many ups and downs.
ex.zh: 這家公司的歷史起起伏伏，波折不斷。

ex.en: I like chewy noodles more than soft ones.
ex.zh: 比起軟的麵條，我更喜歡有嚼勁的。

ex.en: These chewy candies stick to your teeth.
ex.zh: 這些有嚼勁的糖果會黏牙。

ex.en: The teacher caught him cheating on the exam.
ex.zh: 老師抓到他考試作弊。

ex.en: Cheating in a game ruins the fun for everyone.
ex.zh: 在遊戲中作弊會毀了大家的樂趣。

ex.en: She found out he was cheating on her.
ex.zh: 她發現他背著她劈腿。

ex.en: Cheating on a partner can destroy trust.
ex.zh: 對伴侶不忠會摧毀信任。

ex.en: The changeover to the new system will take a week.
ex.zh: 換成新系統需要一個星期。

ex.en: There was some confusion during the changeover.
ex.zh: 轉換期間出現了一些混亂。

ex.en: We ordered a bowl of clam chowder.
ex.zh: 我們點了一碗蛤蜊濃湯。

ex.en: Fish chowder is popular in coastal towns.
ex.zh: 魚肉濃湯在海邊城鎮很受歡迎。

chauvinism.zh: 沙文主義；偏執的優越感

ex.en: Male chauvinism is still a problem in some workplaces.
ex.zh: 大男人沙文主義在一些職場仍是個問題。

ex.en: Extreme chauvinism can make people hate other countries.
ex.zh: 極端的沙文主義可能讓人憎恨其他國家。

ex.en: Light came in through a chink in the curtain.
ex.zh: 光線從窗簾的縫隙透進來。

ex.en: He peeked through a chink in the fence.
ex.zh: 他從圍籬的小縫往外偷看。

ex.en: The glasses chinked as they said cheers.
ex.zh: 他們乾杯時，杯子發出叮噹聲。

ex.en: Coins chinked in his pocket as he walked.
ex.zh: 他走路時，口袋裡的硬幣叮噹作響。

ex.en: The family gathered for the baby's christening on Sunday.
ex.zh: 全家人在星期天為寶寶的洗禮聚在一起。

ex.en: She wore a white dress to the christening.
ex.zh: 她穿著白色洋裝出席洗禮。

ex.en: She smiled charmingly and thanked everyone.
ex.zh: 她迷人地微笑並感謝大家。

ex.en: The old café was charmingly decorated with flowers.
ex.zh: 那家老咖啡館用花裝飾得很迷人。

ex.en: The two lived a chaste life in the quiet village.
ex.zh: 兩人在寧靜的村子裡過著清白的生活。

ex.en: It was a chaste kiss on the cheek.
ex.zh: 那只是臉頰上一個純真的吻。

ex.en: He is a real charmer and everyone likes him.
ex.zh: 他是個很有魅力的人，大家都喜歡他。

ex.en: The little girl was a charmer who won over the whole class.
ex.zh: 小女孩很討喜，讓全班都喜歡她。

ex.en: Hummus is made from mashed chickpeas.
ex.zh: 鷹嘴豆泥是用搗碎的鷹嘴豆做成的。

ex.en: I added a can of chickpeas to the salad.
ex.zh: 我在沙拉裡加了一罐鷹嘴豆。

ex.en: She painted the door a bright chartreuse.
ex.zh: 她把門漆成鮮豔的黃綠色。

ex.en: Chartreuse is a color between yellow and green.
ex.zh: 黃綠色是介於黃色與綠色之間的顏色。

chauvinist.zh: 沙文主義者；大男人主義者

ex.en: He was a chauvinist who thought women shouldn't work.
ex.zh: 他是個大男人主義者，認為女人不該工作。

ex.en: Nobody wants to work for a chauvinist boss.
ex.zh: 沒有人想替大男人主義的老闆工作。

ex.en: Paint chipping off the wall showed the house needed repair.
ex.zh: 牆上剝落的油漆碎片顯示房子需要整修。

ex.en: The workers swept up the stone chipping from the floor.
ex.zh: 工人把地上的石屑掃乾淨。

ex.en: Her cheerfulness made the whole class feel happier.
ex.zh: 她的開朗讓全班都跟著快樂起來。

ex.en: He greeted everyone with great cheerfulness.
ex.zh: 他興高采烈地向每個人打招呼。

ex.en: It would be churlish to refuse such a kind offer.
ex.zh: 拒絕這麼好心的提議是很失禮的。

ex.en: His churlish reply made everyone in the room uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他粗魯的回答讓房裡每個人都不自在。

ex.en: The priest lifted the silver chalice during the service.
ex.zh: 神父在儀式中舉起了銀製聖杯。

ex.en: The museum displays a golden chalice from the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 博物館展出一只中世紀的金製高腳杯。

ex.en: I drink chamomile tea before bed to relax.
ex.zh: 我睡前喝洋甘菊茶來放鬆。

ex.en: Chamomile flowers look like tiny white daisies.
ex.zh: 洋甘菊的花看起來像小小的白色雛菊。

ex.en: The cheapness of the fabric shows after a few washes.
ex.zh: 這塊布料的廉價感洗幾次就看得出來。

ex.en: Many shoppers come here for the cheapness of the food.
ex.zh: 許多顧客來這裡是為了食物便宜。

ex.en: The weather here is very changeable in spring.
ex.zh: 這裡春天的天氣變化多端。

ex.en: Her mood is changeable, so it's hard to plan around her.
ex.zh: 她的心情很善變，很難配合她安排。

ex.en: The kids set up the pieces on the checkerboard.
ex.zh: 孩子們把棋子擺在棋盤上。

ex.en: The kitchen floor has a black and white checkerboard pattern.
ex.zh: 廚房地板是黑白相間的方格圖案。

ex.en: The photos are arranged chronologically in the album.
ex.zh: 相簿裡的照片是按時間順序排列的。

ex.en: Please list your jobs chronologically, starting with the most recent.
ex.zh: 請依時間順序列出你的工作，從最近的開始。

ex.en: She sautéed chard with garlic and olive oil.
ex.zh: 她用大蒜和橄欖油炒了甜菜葉。

ex.en: The garden has rows of green chard.
ex.zh: 花園裡種了一排排綠色的甜菜葉。

ex.en: The cliffs have chalky white rock.
ex.zh: 那些懸崖有白堊質的白色岩石。

ex.en: The medicine tasted chalky and bitter.
ex.zh: 這藥吃起來有粉筆味而且很苦。

ex.en: Cheer up! Things will get better soon.
ex.zh: 打起精神來！事情很快就會好轉。

ex.en: He cheered up when he saw his friends at the door.
ex.zh: 他看到朋友出現在門口時就開心了起來。

ex.en: A cup of hot chocolate helped me cheer up.
ex.zh: 一杯熱可可讓我振作了起來。

ex.en: I bought flowers to cheer up my sister.
ex.zh: 我買了花想讓我妹妹開心一點。

ex.en: Let's cheer up Tom with a surprise party.
ex.zh: 我們用驚喜派對讓湯姆開心起來吧。

ex.en: The kids sang songs to cheer up the sick old man.
ex.zh: 孩子們唱歌，想讓生病的老先生開心起來。
